classification_rules.NEW_CHANNEL_FOR_EXISTING_OUTLET: a registry outlet; no earlier file names this address or the feed it documents

disposition_meaning.LATER_WAVE: worth a registration proposal after the waves in hand
disposition_meaning.NEEDS_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: not usable as it stands: no current address
disposition_meaning.WAVE_C: proposed for the third canary wave (a registration proposal exists; nothing is registered)
